content:
maria_cs: Heads-up — ACME asked about an early renewal/expansion: they want a 6mo renewal at a prorated rate, split billing between ACME Ops (US) and ACME EU, and they asked for a 10% escrow holdback tied to onboarding milestones. They prefer CC for the deposit but procurement wants PO for the remaining balance. Thoughts?

lee_sales: Good signal. They said product adoption hit targets so they're ok with the price. The 6mo term is non-negotiable. On PO timing: procurement said they can issue PO within 4 business days but need vendor code + remit info. CC for deposit is likely.

sam_fin: Finance can accept a CC for an initial deposit up to X USD, but we need a documented PO within 5 business days for accounts receivable. For escrow: we will record a holdback line item on the invoice. Need payload for invoice metadata:
```
billing_split: [{"entity":"ACME Ops (US)", "percent":70}, {"entity":"ACME EU", "percent":30}]
deposit_method: card
escrow_holdback_pct: 10
po_number: TBD
```
(share vendor codes + tax numbers ASAP).

olivia_legal: Escrow holdback changes deliverable/liability profile. We should add a short Escrow Addendum referencing milestone schedule and release criteria. Also procurement asked about insurance certificate for EU entity 17. Can someone confirm?

maria_cs: I'll confirm insurance ask now. Quick note to buyer: "We can support a 10% escrow holdback and split invoices. We can take a card for the deposit, pending PO within 5 business days. We'll include an Escrow Addendum that defines milestone release triggers. Is the insurance certificate available?"

lee_sales: Buyer responded: insurance cert attached (see email), PO will follow in ~3 days, and CC for deposit is fine. They want the escrow release tied to two milestones: 1) transfer of data pipeline; 2) completion of training workshop.

sam_fin: OK. Finance requires exact milestone names/acceptance criteria to map to invoice lines. Please provide a short table. Also: set invoice terms to Net30 after PO arrives. Capture payment token for CC deposit as authorization only until PO posted.

olivia_legal: Draft Escrow Addendum (drafted here):
```
Escrow Addendum: Seller will retain 10% of the Renewal Fee in escrow. Release conditions: (a) Data pipeline handoff confirmed in writing by Customer Success, (b) Training workshop completion with attendee list and Customer Success sign-off. Escrow to be released within 5 business days after sign-off. If PO not provided within 5 business days, parties agree to revert deposit to Customer and cancel provisioning.
```
We should also capture procurement contact email on the DocuSign envelope.

(docusign-bot): Template match: "Renewal-Escrow-Addendum" found. Can create envelope with two signers + procurement CC + conditional fields (escrow checkbox, invoice metadata). Reply with: `create envelope` to proceed.

maria_cs: plan: 1) create envelope w/ Escrow Addendum + split invoice metadata; 2) charge card for deposit (auth only) once buyer signs; 3) wait for PO upload; 4) finance finalizes invoice after PO. Any objections?

sam_fin: No objections. Finance will accept an auth hold for deposit and will log PO:TBD on the invoice. Please ensure procurement email is captured.

olivia_legal: Addendum language OK. Two asks: include explicit milestone names exactly as buyer specified and include a clause re: dispute timeline (10 business days to contest release).

maria_cs: Updated addendum text to include milestones & dispute window. Creating envelope now and will paste link.

(docusign-bot): Envelope created: https://docusign.example/envelope/0x9c-acme-escrow-early-renewal. Routing: 1) ACME Ops signer, 2) ACME EU signer, 3) procurement CC (email captured), 4) finance ack. Fields: escrow checkbox, invoice metadata, procurement_email.

lee_sales: Sent to buyer. I'll nudge procurement for PO ETA and confirm milestone acceptance criteria with product.

maria_cs: Next steps: - monitor signing and card auth (I'll confirm when auth run) - sam_fin to finalize invoice after PO arrives - olivia_legal to upload addendum to contract repo - lee_sales to chase PO.

sam_fin: Will mark invoice as provisional with holdback line item and note: "PO must be uploaded within 5 business days or deposit refunded."

maria_cs: Thanks team. Will update when envelope completes or PO uploaded. :spiral_calendar:
